qualification: Bounded complete HTTPS archives, FITS structure, SHA256, internal checksums when available; metadata only. Inventory scan/time groups, classify documented position-switch pairs only if actual physical ON/OFF separation, documented sequence, matching source and CAL phase timelines and >=16 unique nonoverlapping times per scan on fixed IF/pol/feed pass. OTF and other modes inventory-only; no concatenating short scans or counting windows as sessions. Distinct projects are candidates, not proof of statistical independence. No raw spectra exported, no operational detection or production changes.

evaluation_plan.scope: Historical natural astronomy scientific preservation only; independent whole-session split before analysis. Keep G4 and Hybrid R28 frozen. Predeclare metrics for scientific line integrity, false-alarm control on labelled reference observations, sensitivity and total resource cost in any future separately qualified scientific comparison. No tuning on held-out observations. Do not equate metadata or arithmetic PASS with sensitivity or false-alarm improvement.
